source_data: fig_tabular.py fig_bars_only — the exact-vs-off-policy panel of f02 on its own, at PEAK 0.7 over run_headline_p70 (2730 cells, 30 MDPs). Three bars per divergence: exact closed-form inner term over all a' (hatched ///), then the single-logged-action estimator under the Amari normalization f'(1)=0 and under the canonical f'(1)=f''(1), with 95% CIs. Euclidean is dropped from all paper figures — it is a Bregman, not an f-divergence, so it has no canonical bar at all. Built at 7.6x5.0 in with 17pt labels for placement at about half width
